conventions.positions: calc(TT, body, FLG_MOSEPH|FLG_SPEED): apparent geocentric tropical true ecliptic/equinox of date; returned calc flags must equal 260
conventions.times: utc_to_jd(GREG_CAL) supplies TT and Swiss UT1; selected instants match product TT within one JD ulp; Swiss Delta-T differs from Algo5
conventions.houses: houses_ex(Swiss UT1, latitude north positive, longitude east positive, P/E/W, flags=0); returns no flags; default analytic nutation/obliquity
conventions.nodes: SE_MEAN_NODE is a named independent mean-node model; compare longitude and rate only. Swiss conventional distance is retained, not equated with project None. Zero latitude is definitional. Swiss true nodes are excluded.
conventions.derivations: Project-authored separate arithmetic over Swiss values: 30-degree sectors; unwrapped-cusp bisect for 2D longitude membership; five oriented aspect angles, inclusive orbs, relative-rate motion. No astrology/celestial imports. Not a Swiss built-in aspect table.
conventions.rules: All ten physical bodies participate in their requested order; node does not. Five aspect rules, base orb 6 degrees, Sun override 10 degrees, mean of object orbs. Request selection is reversed body order but evaluation follows object order.
conventions.redistribution: Generated numerical output from synthetic inputs only; no Swiss code, ephemeris files or manual prose. Isolated source tool is not a package dependency.

calibration.recipe: 17th of each recorded month, 05:37:13 UTC; March at 64.15,-21.94, September at -33.87,151.21. Source calc flags 260, same TT check. 14 distinct samples, not the four acceptance instants.
calibration.limit: Finite common-epoch calibration, not a global accuracy bound. Unmatched future UTC-to-UT1 fallback samples excluded. Source precision plus project model differences motivate these acceptance thresholds.

tolerances.aspect_deviation: sum of the two longitude tolerances, in degrees
tolerances.rationale: Moon uses truncated project theory; source Moshier is documented as subarcsecond for planets and few-arcsecond lunar class. Other thresholds include model differences in the separate matched calibration. House threshold includes the distinct UT1/Delta-T basis. Distances/rates are empirical acceptance thresholds, not source-published universal error bounds.
